non_blocking_notes: Patch correctly implements all five required negative test cases in focused, minimal scope
Parametrized test expansion adds canonical prefix format validation for target_ref and policy_decision_ref
Refactored high-confidence test into loop efficiently covers all five boundary conditions: trust, mode, action, target_ref format, policy_decision_ref format
Test-only changes eliminate production code risk
result.reasoning_summary: Commit adds exactly the five required direct negative tests for proposal validation boundaries: (1) invalid trust value, (2) invalid mode value, (3) invalid action value, (4) target_ref without canonical prefix, (5) policy_decision_ref without canonical prefix. Two new parametrized cases validate ref format requirements; refactored high-confidence test expands single confidence check into loop testing trust, mode, action conditions alongside confidence. All tests use PROPOSAL_SOURCE_INVALID rejection matching, preventing invalid proposals from proceeding. Patch is narrow (14 lines, single test file), deterministic, and contains no production code changes. Validates tenant/policy/target binding, kill switch engagement requirement, evidence-before-consumption flow, and immutable proposal-stage rejection. No network, provider, or deployment authority involved.
